reviews.text: I have used this clinic  multiple times over the course of about 8 years for different animals.... The Dr is absolutely wonderful... very knowledgeable and doesn't mind taking his time to explain what our furbabies cant communicate to us... I would recommend this clinic to anyone.  The front staff is just as friendly and understanding.  It is a true hidden gem.

We have been coming here for years. My Nana, my mom, and I have all been coming here. They take such great care of all our animals, and are extremely gentle about loss and tough decisions as well... I would never go anywhere else. Prices are reasonable and fair.

Hello everyone, I just want to share this small but very important review about a very bad experience I had with my dog.

Unfortunately, I brought my dog to this place to have his hair trimmed and to get a bath. They did a terrible job. They shaved and trimmed his hair unevenly, and he looked absolutely horrible afterward.

I went back and politely explained that I was not happy with the way they had cut my dog’s hair, but instead of listening to my concerns, they became upset.

The haircut looked careless and unprofessional, almost as if they were playing around with him instead of properly grooming a pet. I felt very bad seeing my poor dog looking like this.

I would definitely not recommend this place for pet grooming. The quality of their work was extremely disappointing. 0/10 — not recommended.

I’m sharing my experience so other pet owners can be aware and think twice before taking their pets there.

Front host and vet nurses were amazing - very sweet and explained their services to me while I filled out some forms.
However my review is based solely on the lack of analysis on behalf of Dr. S.

I see some people have had good experiences here, so I won’t discredit that! Simply I didn’t receive the type of care that was expected. Oh, and for the person who commented “man of few words” you got that right. 🙃

Whilst he seemed nice and was smiling, I couldn’t help but think he had a big hubris and was being a little condescending. We essentially paid $150 for a look-over and left with no real answers, or even a thorough examination of our cats, for an annual check-up. 🙅🏻‍♀️

This is for whomever wants to read my personal account in detail (and I mean in DETAIL):

When he walked in he asked what I came in for, and since it was our first time going there and having pre-established that we wanted an annual check-up for our two 8- year old cats, he said “oh well I only check what seems important or of concern to you”. Umm, excuse me, what?? He didn’t even walk in with any equipment. 🫪
So I listed a series of things that I figured might be worth checking out, such as my cat’s ‘asthma’ attacks, how they eat their food and more-so how they continually throw it up, amongst minor other things. He left and came back with a stethoscope to check one of my cats, said she seemed fine. Proceeds to check my other cats teeth and butt (cuz he do the scoot), and said “looks normal, teeth are healthy”. Looked at his ears, didn’t seem surprised by anything. So then I ask a few questions about longevity - if we wanted to move towards a wet food or raw/ cooked diet for our soon to be senior cats, and he said “DON’T..unless you want to give me all your money because it’s expensive and you will go broke”. Well, that wasn’t the question, it was more-so me asking for advice since I see it everywhere that people do that for their pets, esp once older…but I digress (also who’s to say I don’t have the money 🫣 yikes). I also asked if we should wet the dry food down the road and he also exclaimed no, and that “dry food is meant to be dry food, don’t mess with it”. 😐 No further explanations given.
Overall, he did the bare minimum, and when I say he barely even touched my cats, I mean that. He really just looked at them. 👀

I’ve been to a variety of vets over the years, and each time we get dedicated care and support, including checking their limbs, teeth, claws/paws, urinary/ fecal exams, eyes, nose, ears, signs of bloating and inquiries about their diet and specifically what foods, for how long, and its effects, as well as questions about our day-to-day care, weight and down-the-road steps for recovery or advice on how to improve their lives- all within an annual check-up!
None of that was really discussed here, and I left feeling jaded and scammed out of my money. I thought we would have a discussion, but I really just got A and B answers to my questions, and when I couldn’t come up with other excuses for him to examine my cats, I said “ok I guess that’s it” cuz I didn’t know what else to beg for, like come on! That’s crazy- I shouldn’t have to ask for you to do your job?!

I did ask about services to further diagnose my cat for her asthma- they drafted a huge quote for x-rays. I did end up paying for a calming medication so we could shave her or have someone else do it. They offer it, but I think for the reflection of care this check-up yielded itself as, I’d rather look elsewhere for services and professionalism.

I had high hopes for this place, but I’d rather drive half an hour than 5 minutes down the road with a screaming cat for better care.

Also I’ll attach images of the vet bills and quote for anyone interested in seeing just all of what I paid for.
Dr. Schumacher and the staff take excellent care of my baby. I always get my dog groomed here by Livia, she does an excellent job and my dog loves coming here.
Went in for my Akita’s vaccination and nails trim. Great experience from the receptionist Latoya and Dr. Schumacher!

Outstanding vet! They’re starting off on the right foot with Latoya at the front desk! She’s always the most pleasant and understanding! Helps me handle the business side of things quick and easy! The vet is absolutely amazing! He’s so thoughtful and mindful of things to say that won’t make you feel so bad or concerned! Loved this place! Never going anywhere else. And reasonably priced !!

I took my parrot Gengen. We've been going here 5yrs now. Mrs Latoia is always astonishing! The doctor is super nice and loves the animals.  Thank you for superb service. We appreciate your kindness and great service.
I love taking my bunny here! They are so quick and sweet! Everyone I meet see me with a smile! I also love Latoya so much!

Thank you to Dr. Schumacher and Latoya in the front desk. Latoya thank you for getting us in last minute for our Parrot baby Yoshi and for being so caring and compassionate. And Dr. Schumacher thank you for also being caring and very informative. We are very blessed to have found Greenbrier Veterinary Hospital, May God bless you both.

i took my turtle here when he hurt his arm, and im glad i did! everyone was so kind and comforting, and the service was so quick. i highly recommend them to any turtle keepers. i would give them a bonus star if i could! definitely one of the best vet experience ive had
You cannot ask for a friendlier more welcoming staff than at this vet.  Dr Schumacher is very informative and done a fantastic job with my macaw.  😊
Dr. Schumer really knows his stuff. He saved my Kobes life. He is a man a few words but his actions speaks volumes.  He really cares about your pet.
Reasonable prices. Great for basic veterinarian care.

Dr. Schumacher was very nice and informative at my pet's wellness exam and the prices were reasonable to have a growth removed on my dog's paw. The staff at the front desk were very friendly and my dog loved everyone there. Happy to have found our new vet!
Great place for your fur babies and other babies too.  They took great care of Kiwi cockatiel.
Amazing service , check in was fast and easy , doctor was very understanding and explained everything very clearly , thankyou!
Very kinda and friendly staff. Dr. is great with  reptiles and very informative

The office staff is not the office staff they used to have.  Whoever is in the office now, they are rude.  And by their responses on these reviews, they are condescending and unprofessional.  Quality and attitude has suffered over the decades of going there.  I'm sure the office is glad that I found a better place that knows how to act like professionals and knows how to treat people and their pets.  Yes, I know you people in the office don't care.  That's the problem, YOU DON'T CARE !!
Schumacher is the best.  He's so knowledgeable and truly cares about your fur/scale/ feather babies
This is the only place I will take my dog.  Dr. Schumacher is the best.

I do not recommend anyone bringing in their pet here. On their website they say “At Greenbriar Veterinary Hospital, your pet's health is our number one priority, we are proud to provide experienced, personalized professional Veterinary care.”. I feel like my pets health wasn’t prioritized because the consultation I had with Dr.Shumacher was very rushed. I went in to see what was wrong with my female cat lumps on her chest, all Dr.S said what that my cat was going through a false pregnancy and that her lumps would get smaller. Didn’t care to prescribe any anti- inflammatory medications.  I left the vet still feeling like uneasy, when I should’ve left confident in my cat that she would be okay. The next day her lumps increased in size when the Dr said they would decrease. The reassurance that my cat was fine didn’t align with the growth of her lumps the next day!!!! I’m so disappointed in this place just because the consultation with Dr for probably 5 minutes was 59$, 5 min time just doesn’t justify the 59$ fee, especially when he just said that most basic things, being so careless about her lumps. I feel like Me and my cat were not taken seriously. They don’t want to give me a refund either. I’m so upset because I can use that money somewhere else where they will actually care about my cats health. The appointment felt more like a quick in-and-out session rather than a genuine effort to understand my cat's needs. I left feeling unsatisfied and unsure if my cat received the proper care.
Reading through other reviews, it seems like I'm not the only one who has experienced this.
As a pet owner, it's disheartening to feel like my cat's health is being prioritized below efficiency.
I hope the clinic takes these concerns seriously and works to improve their bedside manner.

yea. No one got hurt. FORTUNATELY. Because the Dr. just got free money. For telling people what they want to hear. In hope it’s true for their pets safety. Contradicting themselves saying her lumps should decrease. When they’ve been increasing more and more everyday.
Dr Schumacher was great and Melody was very courteous. I’ll be back.
A very good experience. The doctor was very kind, and all his staff were very friendly. I highly recommend him, 10 out of 10.
